name: RAN (Region Attention Network)
authors_or_creators: Kai Wang, Xiaojiang Peng, Jianfei Yang, Debin Meng, Yu Qiao - Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT), Chinese Academy of Sciences
accuracy_fer2013: [uncertain] (not the primary benchmark in the paper)
accuracy_rafdb: 86.90% (Overall accuracy on RAF-DB basic subset, ResNet-18 backbone)
pretrained_weights_available: partial - reference implementation and trained weights linked from the official GitHub repo [uncertain]
inference_fps_or_latency: [uncertain] - not explicitly reported in the paper
hardware_requirements: Training on a single NVIDIA GPU (e.g. GTX 1080 Ti / Titan X class); inference is lightweight given ResNet-18 backbone [uncertain]
loss_function: Region Biased Loss (RB-Loss) ensuring the most discriminative region's attention weight exceeds other regions, combined with standard cross-entropy classification loss
training_data_used: RAF-DB, AffectNet, FERPlus, plus authors' own Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB / Occlusion-FERPlus / Pose-FERPlus / Occlusion-AffectNet test sets
pretraining_strategy: supervised-pretrain (ImageNet pretrained backbone), with optional MS-Celeb-1M face recognition pretraining for some variants [uncertain]
input_modality: RGB image (full face plus a fixed set of cropped sub-regions extracted from the face image)
cross_dataset_generalization: [uncertain] - paper focuses on within-dataset and on dedicated occlusion/pose splits rather than full cross-dataset transfer
robustness: Designed specifically for occlusion- and pose-robust FER. Reports strong gains on the proposed Occlusion-RAF-DB, Pose-RAF-DB (30/45 deg), Occlusion-FERPlus, Pose-FERPlus, and Occlusion-AffectNet benchmarks; the region-attention mechanism downweights occluded regions
explainability: Per-region attention weights provide interpretable visualization showing which face regions the model relies on; compatible with Grad-CAM-style analysis
deployment_target: server-GPU (also feasible on edge given the small ResNet-18 backbone)
